summary: Batch 2 QA pass for Tools tab (Today folder + loose tiles). Backend template rendering fix verified (no U+2014, no 'your new .' in /api/tasks response; direct call to scheduler.resolve_template_variables returns 'new ride' fallback and vehicle name when provided). Frontend headers/routes render correctly with correct titles and back navigation. Several regressions/misses found: (a) AI Follow-ups: pending badge and info-card exist visually but are missing the ai-outreach-pending-badge / ai-outreach-info-card data-testid attributes; (b) Inventory as super admin (forest): inventory-feed-btn and inventory-csv-btn are NOT rendered though the spec requires them for admin - the isManager gate is likely excluding super_admin-without-store; (c) Touchpoints: em-dashes still appear inside suggested_message copy on rendered task cards (e.g. 'if anything comes up — I\'m here for you.') even though GET /api/tasks strips them - suggests those messages come from a different endpoint / are cached in the payload the UI actually loads; (d) Touchpoints: while the contact NAME header now shows the formatted number (e.g. '(555) 000-1234'), the raw digits '5550001234' still leak inside the suggested_message body itself ('Hi 5550001234, how\'s everything...') because the template renderer substitutes {first_name} with the raw phone when first_name is missing.

minor.issue: Suggested messages substitute raw 10-digit phone into greetings when contact has no first_name (e.g. 'Hi 5550001234, ...'). Backend _fill_missing_contact_names formats the contact display name but does not sanitize {first_name} inside the template body.

Some existing tasks in preview DB still contain em-dashes in suggested_message (visible in UI). Route strips em-dash on serialize which is now working (test PASS), so likely cached in a separate endpoint or the UI pulls from /api/ai-outreach/campaign data where em-dash is NOT stripped.

ui_bugs.issue: Gold '105' pending count badge is visible but the data-testid ai-outreach-pending-badge is missing (query returned null). Same for the info card - visible but ai-outreach-info-card testid not present.

For super admin (forest@imosapp.com) the toolbar buttons inventory-feed-btn ('Inventory feed') and inventory-csv-btn ('Import CSV') are NOT rendered. Spec: they should show for this admin user. isManager check likely excludes super_admin who has no store_id.

Suggested messages contain em-dashes on visible cards (e.g. Post-Purchase Follow-Up: '... comes up — I\'m here for you.' and 'No pressure — just thought I\'d ask!'). Also campaign step titles like 'Step 2 — Review link'. Backend strip on _serialize is not covering these payloads reaching the UI.

When contact has only a phone, the suggested_message greeting renders 'Hi 5550001234, ...' - raw digits leak inside the message body because template subs {first_name} with the phone string. Header contact chip IS correctly formatted as (555) 000-1234.

issues: Off-brand blue rgb(0,122,255) and purple rgb(175,82,222) still present in numerous inline styles across /touchpoints (stat tile counts CALLS/EMAILS/TEXTS etc), /touchpoints/performance (metric tiles), /leads (segmented stats), /dates-calendar (calendar dots/chevrons), /ai-outreach (Tap to load link). These appear to be the intentional semantic per-metric colors and Call=blue action buttons the spec whitelists, so they are FINE for stat tiles - but should be double-checked for /leads segmented tab pills (11px 700 blue counters) and /dates-calendar calendar highlight/chevron which are not per-metric stat tiles.

Header titles observed - /touchpoints: 'Today\'s Touchpoints' ✓ | /touchpoints/performance: 'My Numbers' ✓ | /ai-outreach: 'AI Follow-ups' ✓ | /inventory: 'Inventory' ✓ | /leads: 'Internet Leads' ✓ | /dates-calendar: 'Calendar' ✓. All six shared ScreenHeader routes render, no blank screens.

action_items: Add missing data-testid ai-outreach-pending-badge on the gold '105' count pill and ai-outreach-info-card on the info card in frontend/app/ai-outreach.tsx.
Fix isManager gate in frontend/app/inventory.tsx so super_admin (role super_admin, possibly without store_id) sees inventory-feed-btn and inventory-csv-btn as required by spec.

Sanitize em-dash on the payload used by touchpoints list (likely a different endpoint than /api/tasks/{user_id}, or ensure em-dash strip runs on all suggested_message-producing endpoints, incl. campaign step content).
Template renderer should not substitute raw phone digits into {first_name}. If contact has no first_name, fall back to 'there' or the formatted phone (555) 000-1234, never raw 5550001234.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/scheduler.py resolve_template_variables: verify {first_name} fallback path - when contact.first_name missing but phone is present, do not silently use raw phone as name; use 'there' or formatted phone.
backend/routers/tasks.py _serialize em-dash strip should also apply to campaign step title/name fields, not just suggested_message.
frontend/app/inventory.tsx isManager check should include role in ['admin','super_admin','store_manager'] regardless of store_id.
test_credentials: forest@imosapp.com / Admin123! (super_admin), mjeast1985@gmail.com / NavyBean1! (rep) - both verified working.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_batch2_touchpoints.py passes (scheduler direct call + tasks GET filter). Regressions to re-verify after fixes: (1) inventory-feed-btn / inventory-csv-btn visibility for forest at 390x844, (2) ai-outreach-pending-badge / ai-outreach-info-card testids present, (3) no em-dash in visible touchpoint suggested messages, (4) no raw 10-digit phone inside suggested_message body. Rep view (mjeast) confirmed feed/csv correctly hidden.
rca of the issue: Inventory admin toolbar: isManager guard likely gated on store_id or specific manager role, excluding forest (super_admin, no store_id in preview per credentials file). AI-outreach testids: components rendered but the testID/dataSet.testid props were probably not wired in the recent Batch-2 rewrite that centralized to ScreenHeader. Em-dash leak: /api/tasks/{user_id} is clean (backend test confirms), so the touchpoints list must be pulling suggested_message from a different endpoint (likely campaign template resolve path or /api/tasks with a different query) where the em-dash strip is not applied. Phone-in-body: template resolver treats contact.first_name || contact.phone as name substitute; needs an explicit guard.
